annotations.title: Check a brand: who it is, where it stands, what comes next

description: First question about one brand: how often AI recommends it and who is picked instead. Takes the brand's website (best), its name or a brd_ id, and answers in one call. For a brand Parse knows well: its Recommended share in each of its markets, most recommended first, with its share named beside it as the detail; the brands recommended most in the market where it is recommended most; and the topic it loses on. No brand score. For one it knows little or nothing about: that fact, and the step that measures it. For a name several companies share: the list to put to the person, with nothing read until they pick. data.kind says which (measured, thin, unplaced, which, unseen). next holds what follows: who is named instead, and how the brand compares with a rival on price or another axis (query_metrics comparisons by versus_brand and axis). Finding the brand is free; a measured brand's standing is one or two query_metrics reads, free: with credits every row; without, samples and aggregates (own brands in full).

subject.description: the brand's website (best: it settles which company), its name, or a brd_ id
